title: 第13章 虽远必诛第14章 学院到来
content_zh:
灵气化剑气，瞬间斩杀两位高手！
惊呆了所有人。
正在店铺中准备看好戏的人，都是顿感不妙，急忙离开，眼神惊恐。
谁能想到，这年纪不大的少年修为如此之高，并且出手这么狠辣。
常老不自觉咽了口唾沫，继而眼神中浮现出惶恐之色。
身后的妙龄女子脸色更是苍白无血。
林震天，这位在范城中天不怕，地不怕的林家当代族长，此时神色凝重到了极点，艰难说道：“玄武境四重，你…是清风城的牧帆？”
眼前的少年，年纪绝对不超过十五，然而修为却有玄武境四重！
在林震天的记忆中，只有一年多以前，牧族的那位武道天才牧帆！
而且，这些天，范城内的人都隐约听到牧帆已经可以重新修炼，并且天赋更胜以往。
这么一来，眼前的少年，极有可能就是牧帆！
“人不犯我，我不犯人。”
“人若犯我，虽远必诛！”
语落，牧帆出手，身影从原地爆射出去，一拳打向林震天，速度快如闪电。
林震天虽然有玄武境二重，但是牧帆的速度实在太快了，根本来不及做出任何反应，就被牧帆一拳轰飞出去，砸入店铺之中，砸坏了不少东西，发出“轰”
的响声。
妙龄女子急忙过去搀扶。
面对牧帆，常老强装镇定，用带着惊恐的声音谄媚道：“误会！
这位少侠，刚刚是一场天大的误会！”
林震天也被扶起，嘴角还有鲜血，脸色苍白得很。

牧帆的随意一拳，可是接近玄武境七重的，硬扛下来，自然不容易！
此时的林震天哪里还敢摆架子，急忙附和常老，“对，刚刚是误会！”
说话间，林震天从储物灵戒中拿出刚刚收下的身法武技，给身旁妙龄女子，“小云，还不赶紧拿给这位少侠。”
妙龄女子点头，拿着武技，给牧帆双手奉上，身子还略带颤抖。
牧帆将武技收下，随后唤出惊鸿。
握住剑，整个人的气势为之一变。
“噗！”
牧帆废话不多说，直接挥剑，一道凛冽无比的剑气斩出。
常老的头颅顿时飞了出去，鲜血横飞。
妙龄女子吓得急忙逃窜。
牧帆没有去管女的，迈步走向林震天，淡然道：“我说过，人若犯我，虽远必诛！
想要杀我，就得做好死在我手中的准备！
content_en:
The spiritual energy turned into sword energy, instantly killing two masters!
Everyone was shocked.
People who were in the store getting ready to watch the show suddenly felt something bad and hurriedly left with frightened eyes.
Who would have thought that this young boy would have such a high level of cultivation and be so ruthless in his attacks.
Chang Lao swallowed unconsciously, and then a look of fear appeared in his eyes.
The face of the young woman behind him was even more pale and bloodless.
Lin Zhentian, the current patriarch of the Lin family who is not afraid of heaven or earth in Fan City, looked extremely solemn at this time, and said with difficulty: "Fourth level of Xuanwu Realm, you...are Mu Fan of Qingfeng City?"
The young man in front of him is definitely no more than fifteen years old, but his cultivation level is at the fourth level of Xuanwu Realm!
In Lin Zhentian's memory, only more than a year ago, Mu Fan, the martial arts genius of the Mu clan!
Moreover, these days, people in Fan City have vaguely heard that Mu Fan has been able to practice again and his talent is better than before.
In this case, the young man in front of me is most likely Mu Fan!
"I won't offend anyone unless they offend me."
"If anyone offends me, he will be killed no matter how far away he is!"
As soon as he finished speaking, Mu Fan took action, and his figure shot out from the spot, punching Lin Zhentian as fast as lightning.
Although Lin Zhentian was at the second level of Xuanwu Realm, Mu Fan's speed was too fast. He had no time to react and was sent flying by Mu Fan's punch, smashing into the shop and breaking many things. He let out a "Boom!"
sound.
The young woman hurried over to help him.
Facing Mu Fan, Chang Lao pretended to be calm and flattered in a frightened voice: "Misunderstanding!
This young hero just had a huge misunderstanding! "
Lin Zhentian was also helped up. There was blood at the corner of his mouth and his face was very pale.
Mu Fan's casual punch was close to the seventh level of Xuanwu Realm, so it was not easy to withstand it!
At this time, Lin Zhentian didn't dare to put on airs, and hurriedly agreed with Chang Lao, "Yes, it was just a misunderstanding!"
As he spoke, Lin Zhentian took out the movement and martial arts skills he had just collected from his storage ring and gave them to the young woman beside him, "Xiao Yun, why don't you hurry up and give them to this young hero."
The young woman nodded and offered the martial arts to Mu Fan with both hands, her body still trembling slightly.
Mu Fan put down his martial arts skills and then summoned Jinghong.
Holding the sword, his whole aura changed.
"Poof!"
Mu Fan didn't say much nonsense, he just swung his sword and slashed out with an extremely cold sword energy.
Chang Lao's head flew out immediately, blood flying everywhere.
The young woman was so frightened that she ran away in a hurry.
Mu Fan ignored the girl and walked towards Lin Zhentian, saying calmly: "I said, if anyone offends me, he will be punished no matter how far away he is!
If you want to kill me, you must be prepared to die in my hands!
